The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V4-L-jakkureysencampment_ai-2022-08-31.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates of the card-size image (<code>large</code> folder) in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); pixel-identical re-uploads are not. The image uses the PC's short game-text symbol “▼ Rey” for “deploy Rey here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” (the wording of the PC card data). '''Errata mark:''' the first image of this Alternate Image card already prints “E1” (it follows the errata count of the card's text); recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
